ruling: The submitted Rose and Damascena lettering does not satisfy the frozen VQ-2 receipt-validation contract. Baked non-uniform compression of an existing font outline is prohibited derivation, and the absence of active transform operators does not cure it.

decisive_evidence.purpose: to force glyphs and words into the measured target widths

zero_active_transforms_proves: only that the submitted files contain NORMALIZED paths. It does not prove those paths were natively authored at their final proportions.

permitted: ordinary UNIFORM conversion from font design units to a working size (any magnitude, sx == sy)
a genuinely condensed licensed typeface used without non-uniform distortion
glyph paths authored directly at their intended final proportions
prohibited: horizontal compression of an existing font outline
vertical distortion of an existing font outline
different compression factors applied per glyph
word-group scaling used to force composition
expanding or baking distorted geometry to remove visible transform matrices
applies_to: distortion expanded or baked into the final paths
derivation_rule.zero_active_transforms_proves: only that the submitted files contain NORMALIZED paths. It does not prove those paths were natively authored at their final proportions.
derivation_rule.vertical_finding_clarification: A non-unit sy is NOT prohibited by itself. VQ2_VERTICAL_GLYPH_SCALING_DETECTED fires only on evidence of vertical distortion independent of canonical uniform size conversion.

vertical_finding_clarification: A non-unit sy is NOT prohibited by itself. VQ2_VERTICAL_GLYPH_SCALING_DETECTED fires only on evidence of vertical distortion independent of canonical uniform size conversion.

ai8_source_authority.rejected_because: the frozen handoff contract requires a NEW native designer-authored Illustrator document with native layer and designer provenance

owner_approval: VQ2_OWNER_APPROVAL_MISSING — approval cannot occur while the asset is contractually invalid
